scope: The integrated Highway VQSort adaptation under GCC 14.2 ASan/debug target builds.

initial_failure.symptom: BaseCase called a null entry in its small-network function table for a 129-256 lane partition.

mechanism.upstream_contract: Highway forces HWY_IS_DEBUG_BUILD=1 under ASan and omits its 256-key sorting network in that shape.
mechanism.local_defect: The adapted SortConstants selected the release 16-column threshold from NDEBUG, so ASan RelWithDebInfo still admitted the omitted function-table slot.
mechanism.fix: Select the adapted threshold from HWY_COMPILER_MSVC || HWY_IS_DEBUG_BUILD, the same authority that controls the network implementation.
mechanism.release_hot_path_change: none; non-sanitized GCC/AppleClang release and the existing MSVC branch retain their prior compile-time value

verification.shape: locked/offline dependency positive and negative contract
